rejected_or_unused.reason: Attempted 2026-10-24 on overpass.private.coffee and overpass.kumi.systems; both timed out or returned dispatcher errors on a trivial query, so the Geofabrik extract is the OSM source. overpass-api.de was not used because its robots.txt disallows /api/.
Named island-level stops only; no jetty names or coordinates, so used for matching only.
No machine-readable public terminal list with coordinates was identified; not scraped.
rejected_or_unused.source: MTCC / Ministry of Transport / Ports Limited lists

sources.attribution: Contains data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database Licence (ODbL) 1.0: https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
sources.query_text: Whole-country Geofabrik extract; objects matching the selectors in harbour_pipeline/overpass.py (SELECTORS plus route=ferry) kept if any coordinate lies in the study bbox plus margin.

sources.outcome: No public harbour, jetty, port or terminal layer. Island layer is used only for island assignment.
sources.query_text: GET <services_url>?f=json and <service>/FeatureServer?f=json for each FeatureServer; keyword match on names/descriptions: ['harbour', 'harbor', 'jetty', 'port', 'pier', 'quay', 'terminal', 'marina', 'wharf', 'dock']
